Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — AcmeTech procurement and security teams are starting final diligence and have asked for our CSA CAIQ responses and a clear mapping to CCM controls. Specifically they want:

- A completed CAIQ workbook (answers for all applicable questions)
- A short control-to-artifact mapping (which artifact proves the control)
- Named owners for each control/response and a point of contact for follow-ups
- Evidence samples (logs, diagrams, policy excerpts) for a small subset of controls (we listed the controls below)

Timeline: procurement is asking to have the consolidated package by COB Nov 25 so they can attach it to the contract approval packet.

Controls they prioritized: IAM, Key Management, Data Retention, Logging & Monitoring, Network Segmentation.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the mapping and whether you can provide a consolidated zip with the CAIQ workbook + evidence manifest? Also let us know if you need any scope clarifications.

Thanks,
Alice Hammond
Sr. Security Program Manager
AcmeTech
